explain XXXXX in english without using word XXXXX?

how can i explain the XXXXX in english without using word XXXXX.like how i explain the XXXXX with word XXXXX.
this is my current code:
package com.example.product;

public class question1 {

public static void main(string[] args) {
    string answer = "hello there!";
    string XXXXX = "my XXXXX";

    system.out.println("the XXXXX is: " + answer);
    system.out.println("answer: " + XXXXX);
    system.out.println("answer: " + answer);
    system.out.println("here is the XXXXX's address: " + answer);

}

}

but this doesn't work. i want to explain the XXXXX in english instead of how i explain the XXXXX in english.

a:

you should use java.lang.string instead of string.
public class question1 {

    public static void main(string[] args) {
        string answer = "hello there!";
        string XXXXX = "my XXXXX";
